title: Pull a slip-sheet from under a load while bracing it
instruction: Take the white sheet out from under the orange block without moving the block: it must end up resting on the table where it was.
context: Hand material movers (O*NET 53-7062 Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand, about 3 million US workers) break down pallets all shift; slip-sheets and liners between layers or under a load are pulled out by hand while the other hand steadies the load, many times a shift. A load dragged along with the sheet tips or lands off its pad onto the worker. A robot that braces and pulls takes people out of that exposure. Closest on the board: unload and lift tasks; this one is friction extraction with a braced load, not grasp and move.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the two arm bases, on the table (x forward, y left). Sheet: rigid white laminate-like slab 26 x 26 cm, 4 mm thick, friction 0.3, with a rigid green PVC-like tab 4 cm (x) by 6 cm (y) by 4 cm tall fixed on its +y edge (tab centre y 19); slab and tab together 150 g; slab centre at x 30, y 4. Block: rigid orange 8 cm cube (hollow plastic or wood-like), 350 g, friction 0.3, centre x 30, y 0, standing on the middle of the sheet (its bottom 4 mm above the table).
scoring: Measured at the end with a ruler and set square. Block height is its lowest edge above the tabletop. 0 if, at any time after the first 2 s, the block was lifted more than 1 cm, tilted more than 20 degrees or moved more than 8 cm. 0.25 if the sheet was pulled 6 cm toward +y; 0.5 if pulled 10 cm, or if it is fully out but the block moved 2.5-8 cm, or fully out but the block is held more than 3 mm above the tabletop (a suspended block never scores above 0.5); 0.75 if the sheet is fully out (its edge 5 mm clear of the block's footprint), the block rests on the table and moved 1.2-2.5 cm or is tilted 5-20 degrees (also shown while the full conditions hold but the 1 s has not yet passed); 1.0 only if the sheet is fully out, the block rests on the table (bottom within 3 mm of it), moved at most 1.2 cm, is tilted at most 5 degrees, and block and sheet stay still for a full 1 s in a row.
reset_notes: Lay the sheet back under the block at the marked spot, tab toward +y.
fidelity: Rigid boxes; the sheet is a rigid 4 mm slab with a tab (no bending), friction 0.3 on all contacts. Scoring is computed from measured poses; nothing is code-driven. The 40 mm tab is much stiffer than a real sheet's pull strip. A real slip-sheet is flexible; this tests extraction by friction shear with a braced load, not sheet flexure. Block and sheet are scale models: real loads are 2-10 kg; the 350 g block and 260 mm sheet fit the arm's payload and reach.
